1. 1. Getting Started

The Example Guide

Reading Files

A program reads a file in one call. The listing hides the lines that only make it compile.

Filename: src/main.rs

use std::fs;
fn main() -> std::io::Result<()> {
let text = fs::read_to_string("notes.txt")?;
println!("{} bytes", text.len());
Ok(())
}

Run it:

$ cargo run
   Compiling notes v0.1.0
42 bytes

Note: the file must be UTF-8.
